scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix qzr-ai-be && npm --prefix qzr-ai-be run db:generate && npm install --prefix qzr-ai-tanstack
scripts.setup:env: test -f .env || cp .env.example .env; test -f qzr-ai-be/.env.docker || cp qzr-ai-be/.env.docker.example qzr-ai-be/.env.docker
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose exec backend npm run db:migrate
scripts.docker:index: docker compose exec backend npm run index:csv
scripts.docker:setup: npm run setup:env && npm run docker:up && docker compose exec backend npm run setup:docker
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix qzr-ai-be run typecheck && npm --prefix qzr-ai-tanstack run typecheck
